rule: Hand labels for the three Important findings of the W17 final review. Q = a cut relation whose plane the closed vocabulary cannot pin: the program is mathematically right, so the label is INVARIANT, but §15.1 (closed vocabulary, unverifiable binding refused) requires a refusal — and the refusal must say 'not provable' (ASSUMPTION_INVARIANCE_UNPROVEN, cause UNKNOWN), never 'the program cut another plane' (CONSTRUCTION_NOT_TEXT_BOUND). G = a datum in a ', biết …' clause of a sentence that ends with '?': it is a premise and the request is served. Base of every Q row: gold p1 text (pyramid S.ABCD, coordinates given) + the stated sentence + 'Tính diện tích thiết diện (T).'; program = p1 points/base/solid + midpoints M, N, P, Q of SA, SB, SC, SD + construct_plane through M, N, P (the plane through M parallel to the base) + construct_section + area. Base of every G row: the W14 triangular-pyramid payload (AB = 3, AC = 4, SA ⊥ base) with the stated text.
